question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Infallible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Infallible"** refers to something or someone that is incapable of making mistakes or being wrong; it never fails. (अचूक)

 
 
• **Example: **He was considered an infallible expert in his field, always providing the right solutions.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the concept of being incapable of making mistakes or being wrong is described by the term **'infallible'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Infallible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unreliable** (अविश्वसनीय): Not able to be relied upon; lacking in consistency or accuracy.

 
 
• **Example:** Due to his history of arriving late, he is considered unreliable for time-sensitive tasks.
 
 
 
• **Fallible** (भूल-सुधार संभव): Capable of making mistakes or being erroneous.
 
 
• **Example:** Despite being highly skilled, even the best professionals are fallible at times.
 
 
 
• The word "risky" means something that involves exposure to danger or the possibility of losing something of value. (जोखिमी)
 
 
• Example: Investing in the stock market can be risky without proper research and strategy.
